topic: Health, Life Sciences and Care Systems
title: Adjusting Imports of Pharmaceuticals and Pharmaceutical Ingredients into the United States
key_claim: A 100% Section 232 tariff on patented pharmaceuticals and APIs takes effect 31 July 2026 (Annex III companies) and 29 September 2026 (others); 20% for firms with approved onshoring plans; zero for companies with MFN pricing agreements; generics and biosimilars excluded.
signals_supported: US Section 232 pharma tariffs and MFN pricing
verbatim_quote: I have determined that it is necessary and appropriate to impose a 100 percent ad valorem duty rate on the import of patented pharmaceuticals and associated pharmaceutical ingredients; the ad valorem duty rate be 20 percent on imports produced by companies that have plans, approved by the Secretary, to onshore production; According to the Food and Drug Administration, as of 2025, approximately 53 percent of patented pharmaceutical products distributed domestically are produced outside the country.
